title: CVE-2024-6387 (regreSSHion) 漏洞分析与修复

sources.title: CVE-2024-6387 Detail - NVD
sources.key_facts: CVSS v3.1 Base Score: 8.1 (HIGH); CVSS Vector: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H; CWE-362 (Race Condition), CWE-364 (Signal Handler Race Condition); Published: 2024-07-01; Affected: OpenSSH 8.5p1 through 9.7p1 on glibc-based Linux

sources.title: GHSA-2x8c-95vh-gfv4 - Signal handler race condition in OpenSSH sshd
sources.key_facts: GHSA ID: GHSA-2x8c-95vh-gfv4; Severity: High; CVSS: 8.1; EPSS Score: 63.835% (98th percentile); Patched in OpenSSH 9.8; References NVD and Qualys research

sources.title: regreSSHion: Remote Unauthenticated Code Execution Vulnerability in OpenSSH Server - Qualys Blog
sources.key_facts: ~14 million potentially vulnerable internet-facing instances; ~700,000 Qualys customer external instances vulnerable (31%); Exploitation requires ~10,000 attempts; Lab exploitation: 6-8 hours total; glibc-based Linux required; OpenBSD unaffected; Regression introduced Oct 2020 in OpenSSH 8.5p1

sources.title: oss-security: CVE-2024-6387 - RCE in OpenSSH's server, on glibc-based Linux systems
sources.key_facts: Original CVE disclosure; Affected: OpenSSH 8.5p1 to < 9.8p1; Regression of CVE-2006-5051; Regression introduced by commit 752250c (Oct 2020); DO_LOG_SAFE_IN_SIGHAND removed from sigdie(); CWE-362, CWE-400; SIGALRM handler calls syslog() which is not async-signal-safe; Fix: set LoginGraceTime 0 as workaround; Disclosure: 2024-07-01

sources.title: OpenSSH 9.8 Release Notes
sources.key_facts: Release date: 2024-07-01; Fixes CVE-2024-6387 affecting 8.5p1 through 9.7p1; Demonstrated on 32-bit Linux/glibc with ASLR; Exploitation: 6-8 hours in lab; New features: PerSourcePenalties, PerSourcePenaltyExemptList; Credit to Qualys Security Advisory Team

sources.title: RHSA-2024:4312 - Security Advisory - Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9 openssh
sources.key_facts: Errata ID: RHSA-2024:4312; Severity: Important; Issue Date: 2024-07-03; Fixed package: openssh-8.7p1-38.el9_4.1; Addresses CVE-2024-6387; Affects RHEL 9 (x86_64, s390x, ppc64le, aarch64)

sources.title: openssh-portable commit 752250c - revised log infrastructure (regression-introducing commit)
sources.key_facts: Commit hash: 752250caabda3dd24635503c4cd689b32a650794; Author: Damien Miller (djmdjm); Date: 2020-10-16; Message: 'upstream: revised log infrastructure for OpenSSH'; Accidentally removed #ifdef DO_LOG_SAFE_IN_SIGHAND from sshsigdie(), reintroducing CVE-2006-5051 regression; 7 files changed, 154 additions, 133 deletions

sources.title: CVE-2006-5051 - Signal handler race condition in OpenSSH before 4.4
sources.key_facts: CVE-2006-5051; Original signal handler race condition vulnerability in OpenSSH < 4.4; Fixed in OpenSSH 4.4p1 via DO_LOG_SAFE_IN_SIGHAND protection; regreSSHion (CVE-2024-6387) is a regression of this vulnerability

preferences: P1: 所有 JSON 输出使用 2-space indent，字段按字母顺序排列
P2: 技术报告中 CVE 编号统一格式为 CVE-YYYY-NNNNN（含连字符，大写）
P3: 所有工作产物文件名使用 snake_case，不用 camelCase 或连字符
P4: 进度报告和清单须按环境（prod/staging/dev）分组，prod 优先
P5: 执行摘要须含独立 TL;DR 段落，字数不超过 200 字
note: 真实来源充足（8 URL，19 锚点），NVD/GHSA/OpenSSH 官方/Red Hat Errata 均可核实；Workspace 体量约 130k tokens 可达；supersede 设计（LoginGraceTime 0 被撤销改为 MaxStartups）逻辑自洽；需人工确认 RHSA-2024:4340 具体包版本及 CVE-2024-6409 的精确 CVSS 值（建议造数前二次核实）
